title: Seth Rogen Recalls Brad Pitt and 12 Years a Slave Cast Visiting His Set
excerpt:
Actors working on 12 Years a Slave visited the nearby This Is the End production.
Rogen says the comedy set offered a welcome change of mood during a difficult shoot.
body_md:
Seth Rogen has recalled an unusual overlap between two very different films shooting in New Orleans in 2013: Steve McQueen's historical drama 12 Years a Slave and the apocalyptic comedy This Is the End.

Speaking on the Happy Sad Confused podcast, Rogen said Brad Pitt, Michael Fassbender, Chiwetel Ejiofor and other people connected to the drama would occasionally spend time on the comedy set. He described the emotional atmosphere of the slavery drama as understandably heavy, while his own production was full of jokes and a much lighter mood.

Rogen, who later worked with Fassbender on Steve Jobs, remembered the two groups socializing and going out together. The visits gave colleagues from the demanding historical production a chance to relax, and he recalled their interactions with affection and humor.

12 Years a Slave stars Ejiofor as Solomon Northup, a free Black man kidnapped and sold into slavery. Pitt portrays Samuel Bass, who helps Northup regain his freedom. The film went on to win the Academy Awards for Best Picture and Best Adapted Screenplay.

The anecdote is a behind-the-scenes memory rather than an announcement of a new collaboration. It offers a glimpse of how neighboring productions can have radically different working atmospheres and still become part of one another's filmmaking stories.
